ex.en: The test results were inconclusive.
ex.zh: 檢驗結果沒有定論。

ex.en: After hours of discussion, the meeting was inconclusive.
ex.zh: 討論了好幾個小時，會議仍沒有結論。

ex.en: My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
ex.zh: 我朋友正在為新的作業系統設計使用者介面。

ex.en: I didn't like the interface of that operating system.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡那個作業系統的介面。

ex.en: The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
ex.zh: 這個網站的介面沒什麼新意，但很簡潔。

ex.en: The brand paid an influencer to promote its new shoes.
ex.zh: 這個品牌付錢請網紅宣傳新鞋。

ex.en: Many teens want to become influencers.
ex.zh: 很多青少年想當網紅。

ex.en: Now I want to introduce my parents to you.
ex.zh: 現在我要向你介紹我的父母。

ex.en: She introduced me to him at the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對上將我介紹給他。

ex.en: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
ex.zh: 你應該向那個女孩自我介紹的。

ex.en: The company introduced a new four-day work week.
ex.zh: 公司開始實施每週上班四天的新制度。

ex.en: Tomatoes were introduced to Europe from America.
ex.zh: 番茄是從美洲傳入歐洲的。

ex.en: I invited him to the party and he accepted.
ex.zh: 我邀請他參加派對，他答應了。

ex.en: My friend invited me to go out to dinner.
ex.zh: 我的朋友邀請我去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Did you invite her to spend Christmas here?
ex.zh: 你邀請她來這裡過聖誕節了嗎？

ex.en: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
ex.zh: 我們為這次的延誤致歉，造成不便，敬請見諒。

ex.en: Sorry for the inconvenience.
ex.zh: 造成不便，敬請見諒。

ex.en: All of my wife's relatives are my in-laws.
ex.zh: 我太太的所有親戚都是我的姻親。

ex.en: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
ex.zh: 因為我們的孩子結婚了，現在我們成了親家。

ex.en: Last year I suffered from an inflammation of my middle ear.
ex.zh: 去年我得了中耳炎。

ex.en: Ice can help reduce inflammation.
ex.zh: 冰敷可以幫助消炎。

ex.en: We conduct safety inspections here on a regular basis.
ex.zh: 我們定期在這裡進行安全檢查。

ex.en: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.
ex.zh: 韓國接受了國際原子能總署的檢查。

ex.en: The induction program lasts two weeks.
ex.zh: 新進員工訓練為期兩週。

ex.en: All new staff attend an induction on their first day.
ex.zh: 所有新員工第一天都要參加到職訓練。

ex.en: They installed a vending machine at work.
ex.zh: 他們在辦公室安裝了一臺自動販賣機。

ex.en: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
ex.zh: 自從我在房子上裝了太陽能板，電費就少了一半。

ex.en: I want to have a telephone installed.
ex.zh: 我想裝一支電話。

ex.en: She has a strong interest in history.
ex.zh: 她對歷史很有興趣。

ex.en: I lost interest in the game after an hour.
ex.zh: 玩了一個小時我就對那個遊戲沒興趣了。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高的利息。

ex.en: This savings account pays 2% interest.
ex.zh: 這個儲蓄帳戶的利息是 2%。

ex.en: Trump is acting in Russia's interests.
ex.zh: 川普的所作所為符合俄羅斯的利益。

ex.en: It's in your best interest to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 接受這個提議對你最有利。

ex.en: You can pay for the laptop in 12 monthly installments.
ex.zh: 這台筆電可以分 12 期每月付款。

ex.en: I paid the last installment yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天付了最後一期。

ex.en: The final installment of the series comes out next year.
ex.zh: 這個系列的最後一集明年推出。

ex.en: The story will be published in three installments.
ex.zh: 這個故事會分三期刊出。

ex.en: We take inventory at the end of every month.
ex.zh: 我們每個月底盤點庫存。

ex.en: Our inventory of winter coats is running low.
ex.zh: 我們的冬季外套庫存快不夠了。

ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
ex.zh: 請在下一個十字路口右轉。

ex.en: This intersection is dangerous.
ex.zh: 這個十字路口很危險。

ex.en: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.
ex.zh: 你在第二個路口過馬路就到了。

ex.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
ex.zh: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？

ex.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
ex.zh: 醫生說：「我需要檢查一下傷口。」

ex.en: The cadres inspected our school.
ex.zh: 幹部們來視察我們學校。

ex.en: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 湯姆在交通意外中受了重傷。

ex.en: My brother was injured in the car accident.
ex.zh: 我哥在車禍中受傷了。

ex.en: He was slightly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在車禍中受了輕傷。

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。

ex.en: The injured were taken to three different hospitals.
ex.zh: 傷者被送往三家不同的醫院。

ex.en: Why did you buy travel insurance?
ex.zh: 你為什麼買了旅遊保險？

ex.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
ex.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

ex.en: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
ex.zh: 請把這份表格寄給您的保險公司。

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來觀光客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
ex.zh: 出國的人數一直在增加。

ex.en: The number of cars driven in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 在城市裡行駛的車輛數量增加了。

ex.en: There has been a 10% increase in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售額成長了 10%。

ex.en: The price increase surprised many customers.
ex.zh: 漲價讓很多顧客感到意外。

ex.en: Please send the invoice to our accounting department.
ex.zh: 請把請款單寄給我們的會計部。

ex.en: The invoice must be paid within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張請款單須在 30 天內付清。

ex.en: We will invoice you at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 我們會在月底開請款單給您。

ex.en: The supplier invoiced us twice by mistake.
ex.zh: 供應商不小心向我們請了兩次款。

ex.en: Have you got that in stock?
ex.zh: 你們有現貨嗎？

ex.en: Sorry, that size is not in stock right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那個尺寸目前沒有庫存。

ex.en: Tomorrow we will welcome the first intern.
ex.zh: 明天我們會迎來第一位實習生。

ex.en: Tom is just an intern.
ex.zh: 湯姆只不過是實習生。

ex.en: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
ex.zh: 媒體詢問請洽當地的公關或行銷代表。

ex.en: Thank you for your inquiry about our products.
ex.zh: 感謝您詢問我們的產品。

ex.en: We made inquiries into his past.
ex.zh: 我們對他的過去進行了調查。

ex.en: The government has opened an inquiry into the accident.
ex.zh: 政府已經對這起事故展開調查。

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 如果情況有任何變化，請務必通知我。

ex.en: Please inform me of the plan ahead of time.
ex.zh: 請你事先把計劃告訴我。

ex.en: Please keep me informed.
ex.zh: 請隨時通知我最新狀況。

ex.en: Your voice is almost inaudible. Can you move closer to the mic?
ex.zh: 你的聲音幾乎聽不到，可以靠近麥克風一點嗎？

ex.en: He said something inaudible and left the room.
ex.zh: 他小聲說了句聽不清楚的話就離開了房間。

ex.en: I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.
ex.zh: 我明天有大學入學面試，希望能通過。

ex.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你得隨機應變。

ex.en: The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
ex.zh: 採訪者先介紹了這次訪問的主題。

ex.en: The singer gave an interview to a local newspaper.
ex.zh: 那位歌手接受了當地報紙的採訪。

ex.en: I interviewed him.
ex.zh: 我採訪了他。

ex.en: Tom is being interviewed by Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在接受瑪麗的訪問。
